content: Loyauwedo

Taugu Saimoni Pita ta Yesu Keliso ꞌina topaihowa ꞌaigeda, nuwana ꞌana tohepwaila, ꞌimi leta yaleleyawa. Comi ma taugu ꞌida hemisa mahemahetena, ma weyahina tayaliyaya. Hemisaina talobeya ꞌida Yehoba ma ꞌada Toꞌabihetena Yesu Keliso ꞌidi loina bwebweꞌana ꞌoinega.
Yehobaina ma ꞌida Badaina Yesu ꞌadi sanapu ꞌoinega, helau moisa ma yaliyaya ꞌoimiya sihasiwa.

Yehobaina ꞌina waiwaiyega ꞌilemegita, eema ꞌiꞌebwaegita ginaulaedi baibaiwadi yawasida weyahina ta ꞌida mumuga ꞌehauna weyahina. Weyahina tauna tasanapuya ꞌabehega ꞌihesinuwegita ma ꞌane ꞌina wasawasa ta ꞌina mumuga bwebweꞌana ꞌiꞌebwaegita.
Ma wete ꞌina gwae hemisa bwebweꞌadi ma waiwaidi ꞌoidiyega mumuga baleꞌu ꞌana nuwaꞌubunao galadi wahasinedi, eema Yehoba ꞌina mumuga bwebweꞌana waloba.
Coinega watoho waiwai ma ꞌimi hemisa waloheposeyanedi bewa ginaulaedi ꞌoidiyega, nugeta mumuga bwebweꞌana, heluwena sanapu,
hetoina ꞌalamaꞌiꞌitana, ꞌehatana toholopaꞌala, nima ꞌaigeda mumuga ꞌehauna,
hesikisina ꞌahwaꞌiyaꞌiyana, ma ꞌebelosaloha helau.
Ceguma ginaulaedi ꞌoimiya simadomadou moisa, ꞌida Bada Yesu Keliso ꞌana sanapu ꞌoina wahewaiwai, ma geyaꞌabwa ꞌimi paihowa simudamudali.
Ma ꞌeguma ginaulaedi geya ꞌoimiya simiyamiya, ꞌana ꞌita gide mata gibugibuimi, weyahina ꞌami giheꞌehau ꞌimi puiyao mwalo ꞌoidiyega wanuwanaide pwaiya.
Coinega ꞌiyagwao, watoho waiwai ma geyaꞌabwa Yehoba ꞌana hesihesinuwao bodaedi ꞌoidiyega wamiyamiya latu. Ma ꞌeguma ꞌigu gwae bewa wahematamatanedi geyaꞌabwa wabeꞌubeꞌu,
ma ꞌoinega muliyetega maꞌimi yaliyaya waluhu ꞌida Bada ma ꞌada Toꞌabihetena Yesu Keliso ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌoina ma nobwa wamiya hataya.
Coinega nuwanuwagu ma yalohatotogomi ma nuwatuhu bewa wanuwatuhu yahidi, weyahina wasanapu pwaidiya eema sanapu moisa ꞌoimiya ꞌimiyamiya.
Ma tuta bewa mayawasiguwa yamiyamiya, ꞌilobwainegauwa ma yahenuwa lagugomi ma ꞌomi wahetapewa mumuga bwebweꞌana weyahina.
Weyahina ꞌida Bada Yesu Keliso ꞌiheꞌita pwaigauwa ꞌabehega ꞌiꞌiuna ma yaꞌebesinegomi,
ꞌoinega yatohotoho waiwai ma ꞌabehega ꞌabwa ꞌigu ꞌwaiha mulina heꞌitaedi geyaꞌabwa wanuwanuwa sinedi.
Keliso ꞌina ꞌasilala siꞌiteya
Mwalo ꞌida Bada Yesu Keliso ꞌina waiwai ma ꞌina tauyama ꞌahepwailediya ꞌoimiya, ma ꞌima hepwailaina geya tosonosonogao ꞌidi ꞌoteꞌotetelao ꞌoidiyega, ma hesi matamega tauna ꞌina wasawasa ꞌaꞌiteya.

Ma tutaina mwalo mahetemai ꞌoyai ꞌamiyamiya Yehoba ꞌenana galewega ꞌahesagoheya, ꞌigwaeya, “Bewa Natugu moisa, tauna weyahina yayaliyaya madouna.” Ma ꞌenanaina Tamana ꞌina tupwa ꞌehauna galewega ꞌitauyama eeta ꞌoyaina debana Yehoba hepwatu ta wasawasa ꞌasiꞌasilalaina Natuna ꞌiꞌebwaeya.

Ma palopitao mwalo ꞌidi gwae ꞌoidiyega Keliso sihepwaila nugeteya, ta tauma wete ꞌaꞌiteya, ꞌoinega ꞌomi ꞌilobwainegomiya ma gwaeyedi wanuwatuhu yahidi, weyahina gwaeyedi gide wodam tupwa guguyou ꞌoina ꞌiꞌasiꞌasilala ma ꞌana siga gona ꞌiꞌasale ma ꞌubwana ꞌatemiya ꞌisaehane.
Ma ginaula bewa wanuwasabwaleni ꞌabehega palopitao ꞌidi gwae Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌalona geya sawasawahina taboimo ꞌadi gibui tasanapu,
weyahina palopitaowedi geya siboidimo ꞌidi nuwatuhuwega sigwaegwaenedi, ma hesi Yehoba ꞌoinega, ma Yaluyaluwa Tabuna palopitao ꞌihenuwa lagudiya eeta gwaeyedi sigwaenediya.
